# Slayyshine Jewels

> Demifine jewellery brand from India. Waterproof, tarnish-free PVD gold (2.5–5 micron) on 316L medical-grade stainless steel. Hypoallergenic, nickel-free. Tagline: "The jewellery that doesn't leave."

## Key facts
- Category: demifine jewellery (between fast fashion and fine jewellery)
- Materials: 316L stainless steel, PVD gold bond, AAA cubic zirconia, real freshwater pearls
- Price range: ₹699–₹1,799
- Shipping: India, ships in 2–3 days, free above ₹999, easy returns
- Instagram: @slayyshine.jewels
